g.text: make sure u are using the latest PC104

g.desc: make sure u are using the latest PC104

g.text: Please use the same net label neames as used here

g.desc: Please use the same net label neames as used here

g.text: HDMI0 -> HDMI A receptacle J3. TMDS: 100R differential pairs,

g.desc: HDMI0 -> HDMI A receptacle J3. TMDS: 100R differential pairs,

g.text: intra-pair match 0.15 mm. CEC / HPD / DDC connect directly (CM5 has

g.desc: intra-pair match 0.15 mm. CEC / HPD / DDC connect directly (CM5 has

g.text: internal pull-up / pull-down, 5 V tolerant). No ESD parts on CM5.

g.desc: internal pull-up / pull-down, 5 V tolerant). No ESD parts on CM5.

g.text: J3 pin 18 (+5V to sink) from +5V rail via F1 500 mA polyfuse.

g.desc: J3 pin 18 (+5V to sink) from +5V rail via F1 500 mA polyfuse.

g.text: Pin 14 UTILITY not used. Shields / DDC GND -> DGND.

g.desc: Pin 14 UTILITY not used. Shields / DDC GND -> DGND.

g.text: PWR_FLAGs: these rails are supplied by the PC104 bus (EPS board).

g.desc: PWR_FLAGs: these rails are supplied by the PC104 bus (EPS board).

g.text: CM5 5 V in: pins 77-87, up to 2.5 A, from +5V; C2/C3 = bulk

g.desc: CM5 5 V in: pins 77-87, up to 2.5 A, from +5V; C2/C3 = bulk

g.text: decoupling near the module. GPIO_VREF (78) -> CM5_3.3V, so

g.desc: decoupling near the module. GPIO_VREF (78) -> CM5_3.3V, so

g.text: GPIO0-27 are 3.3 V logic. CM5_3.3V (84/86, 600 mA max)

g.desc: GPIO0-27 are 3.3 V logic. CM5_3.3V (84/86, 600 mA max)

g.text: also feeds the Ethernet LEDs and the camera (J4 pin 22).

g.desc: also feeds the Ethernet LEDs and the camera (J4 pin 22).

g.text: All CM5 GND pins -> DGND (= PC104 DGND)

g.desc: All CM5 GND pins -> DGND (= PC104 DGND)

g.text: Unused CM5 pins are marked no-connect. USB 2.0 (103/105) goes to the USB-C block on sheet 2.

g.desc: Unused CM5 pins are marked no-connect. USB 2.0 (103/105) goes to the USB-C block on sheet 2.

g.text: nRPIBOOT (93) is NC -> for rpiboot eMMC programming pull it low with a jumper, or program on a CM5 IO board.

g.desc: nRPIBOOT (93) is NC -> for rpiboot eMMC programming pull it low with a jumper, or program on a CM5 IO board.

g.text: VBAT (76) NC -> no RTC backup. WL/BT_nDisable NC -> use a non-wireless CM5.

g.desc: VBAT (76) NC -> no RTC backup. WL/BT_nDisable NC -> use a non-wireless CM5.

g.text: J4 = Hirose FH12-22S-0.5SH, 22-way 0.5 mm FPC; pinout = CM5IO

g.desc: J4 = Hirose FH12-22S-0.5SH, 22-way 0.5 mm FPC; pinout = CM5IO

g.text: CAM/DISP0 (Pi 5 camera cable). MIPI0 D0..D3 + clock, SDA0/SCL0

g.desc: CAM/DISP0 (Pi 5 camera cable). MIPI0 D0..D3 + clock, SDA0/SCL0

g.text: (1.8k pull-ups inside CM5), CAM_GPIO0 = camera power enable,

g.desc: (1.8k pull-ups inside CM5), CAM_GPIO0 = camera power enable,

g.text: CAM_GPIO1 spare, CM5_3.3V on pin 22. D-PHY pairs 100R diff, 0.15 mm.

g.desc: CAM_GPIO1 spare, CM5_3.3V on pin 22. D-PHY pairs 100R diff, 0.15 mm.
